meta.task: Energy release for periodic cracks in an elastic film (PROBLEM.md)
meta.source: Z.C. Xia & J.W. Hutchinson, Crack patterns in thin films, JMPS 48 (2000) 1107-1131; Sec. 4.2; Eqs. 28, 30 (see also Eqs. 4-12, 27); Eq. 6 notation ambiguity noted in REFERENCE.md Sec. 7
meta.fixed_variables: h, E, nu, k, sigma0 fixed during each increment of crack advance (PROBLEM.md); nu = 0.3 for the tabulated values; ell/H values are normalized sampling locations, not material data

definitions.ell: sqrt(Ebar*h/k) wake decay (interaction) length; Ebar = E/(1-nu^2)

units.G: J/m^2 (energy per advancing crack area; release per unit in-plane advance per tip divided by h)

assumptions: plane-stress film on Winkler foundation f = -k u; linear elasticity; quasistatic
u1 = 0 far from tips (mode-I symmetry); 1D wake states exactly solve the model there
total traction sigma.n = 0 on crack faces (Delta_sigma.n = -sigma0 n), NOT incremental traction
steady simultaneous advance (Case A, one moving tip per period H) vs steady sequential midway advance (Case B, one moving new tip per period 2H; old cracks fixed)
pure mode I by reflection symmetry: KII = 0; G = KI^2/E
energy from the problem's stated incremental functional h*sigma0*eps_gg + (h/2)*Delta_sigma*eps + (k/2)u^2

limits.H/ell->0: gamma_A ~ (H/2*ell)(1-(H/ell)^2/12), gamma_B ~ (H/ell)^3/4; sigma_c,A ~ sqrt(2*Gc*Ebar/H), sigma_c,B ~ 2*sqrt(Gc*Ebar)*ell/H^(3/2) (shielding; sequential cracking arrests at spacing of order ell)
limits.H/ell->inf: gamma_A, gamma_B -> 1; sigma_c -> sqrt(Gc*Ebar/ell) (isolated semi-infinite crack, XH2000 Eqs. 10-12, 27); interaction negligible beyond H ~ 3*ell

numerical_validation.routes: analytic; scipy.solve_bvp collocation strip BVP; independent 2nd-order finite-difference BVP; Simpson quadrature of the stated functional using only numerical v

recommended_comparison_tolerances.G_dimensional: 1e-6 relative, plus any physical-input uncertainty (substrate wavelength dependence, k calibration) which dominates in practice

meta.grade: none (reference preparation only; no experimental grading or physical validation implied)
